pages.title: Residential developments in Dubai | Luxury Realty
pages.description: Explore AVA, ORLA, Atlantis The Royal, Six Senses Dubai Marina, VELA and the Serenity Mansions collections.

pages.title: Atlantis The Royal Residences | Luxury Realty
pages.description: Inspired by the fabled lost city of Atlantis, where ornate baths were plentiful, Atlantis, The Royal Resort & Residences pools reach new, dramatic heights. A 90-metre sky-high infinity pool is the ultimate haven for resort guests and residents to lounge, socialise or play. Under the setting sun, with Dubai glowing on the horizon, the ultra-pool lounge comes alive as the twilight destination for unparalleled sophistication.

pages.title: AVA at Palm Jumeirah | Luxury Realty
pages.description: As the first building at the threshold of the world- renowned Palm Jumeirah, AVA at Palm Jumeirah occupies an incomparable position right at the very centre of Dubai. It is ideally placed to afford privileged access to both the calm of the waterfront and the dynamism of this global city.

pages.title: ORLA | Luxury Realty
pages.description: Your residence at ORLA is your exclusive escape, where indoor and outdoor blend seamlessly with sea and sky, as energising light streams through each residence creating eternal vistas from the moment the sun rises above the horizon to the last golden rays shimmering off the sea below.

pages.title: Serenity Mansions Aurora | Luxury Realty
pages.description: Crafted to stand as an iconic example of luxury in Dubai, Serenity Mansions Aurora offers a collection of bespoke residences designed with meticulous attention to detail. These homes seamlessly blend expansive living spaces with elevated design, complemented by state-of-the-art amenities and personalised services.

pages.title: Serenity Mansions Waterfront Collection | Luxury Realty
pages.description: Designed by the award-winning SAOTA & BLINK to be an emblem of luxury on Dubai’s waterfront, Serenity Mansions Waterfront Collection offers a selection of elegant residences. Each home is crafted with a focus on both form and function, featuring expansive layouts, premium finishes, and breathtaking views of the surrounding water and landscape.

pages.title: Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina | Luxury Realty
pages.description: Residences above the Dubai Marina skyline.

pages.title: VELA | Luxury Realty
pages.description: Bringing together the vibrancy of Downtown Dubai with the peace and prestige of the Marasi Bay waterfront, VELA presents a doorway to an elevated way of life, immersed in beauty and surrounded by energy. The immediate access to the tranquility of the sea, directly from your own marina mooring is extremely special.
